I have updated `.sdlc/runs/20261106-103142-feature-extend-lasso-selection-mode/requirements.md` in place with all three Gate 1 revisions while preserving every existing requirement ID and section:

1. **Bound-to-container text in Wrap vs. Overlap (`FR-8`, `FR-9`, `AC-5`, `AC-8`)**: Clarified that in Wrap (`"contain"`) mode, a bound-to-container text element never counts on its own and never selects its container (the container is selected only when its own outline is fully enclosed, matching box selection), whereas Overlap (`"overlap"`) mode retains today's text-to-container behaviour; added the requirement and acceptance criterion for a Wrap test where a lasso enclosing only a rectangle's bound label selects nothing.
2. **Whole-scene group completeness in Wrap mode (`FR-7`, `AC-6`)**: Specified that Wrap group completeness checks every selectable member of the top-level group (`groupIds.at(-1)`) across all non-deleted elements in the whole scene (`elementsMap` / `getNonDeletedElements()`), not just `this.app.visibleElements`, so an off-screen or non-enclosed member blocks group selection.
3. **Arrow-only bound-label enclosure in Wrap mode (`FR-4`, `AC-2`)**: Restricted the bound-label enclosure rule in `"contain"` mode to arrow labels only (`isArrowElement(element)`), matching `elementsOverlappingBBox`.
